topic: Design share of semiconductor value added, 2019 (SIA/BCG 2021)
disagreement: The same SIA/BCG report says design is '53% of the value added' in running text (p.15) but 50% in the design sidebar (p.15) and Exhibit 4.

different base (e.g. excluding a category) not stated
